parameters.jsCode:
// ▼ 사용자가 바꿀 값은 이 노드에만 있습니다.
const config = {
  githubOwner: 'YOUR_GITHUB_ID',      // GitHub 아이디
  githubRepo: 'ai-news-site',         // 저장소 이름
  githubBranch: 'main',
  contentDir: 'src/content/news',
  siteUrl: 'https://ai-news-site.vercel.app', // 실제 사이트 주소 (Discord 메시지 링크용)
  geminiModel: 'gemini-2.5-flash',
  discordWebhookUrl: '',              // Discord 웹훅 URL (비워 두면 알림 생략)
  aiDays: 7,                          // AI 기사 수집 기간(일)
  worldDays: 3,                       // 국제 기사 수집 기간(일)
  maxPerSource: 10,                   // 매체당 최대 기사 수
  maxTotal: 90,                       // 전체 최대 기사 수
};

// 피드를 추가·삭제하려면 이 목록만 고치세요. trust: 매체 기본 신뢰도(1~5)
const feeds = [
  { category: 'ai', source: 'OpenAI', url: 'https://openai.com/news/rss.xml', trust: 5 },
  { category: 'ai', source: 'Google AI Blog', url: 'https://blog.google/technology/ai/rss/', trust: 5 },
  { category: 'ai', source: 'Google DeepMind', url: 'https://deepmind.google/blog/rss.xml', trust: 5 },
  { category: 'ai', source: 'MIT Technology Review', url: 'https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/artificial-intelligence/feed', trust: 5 },
  { category: 'ai', source: 'Hugging Face', url: 'https://huggingface.co/blog/feed.xml', trust: 4 },
  { category: 'ai', source: 'TechCrunch', url: 'https://techcrunch.com/category/artificial-intelligence/feed/', trust: 4 },
  { category: 'ai', source: 'The Verge', url: 'https://www.theverge.com/rss/ai-artificial-intelligence/index.xml', trust: 4 },
  { category: 'ai', source: 'VentureBeat', url: 'https://venturebeat.com/category/ai/feed/', trust: 4 },
  { category: 'ai', source: 'AI타임스', url: 'https://www.aitimes.com/rss/allArticle.xml', trust: 3 },
  { category: 'ai', source: 'Hacker News', url: 'https://hnrss.org/newest?q=AI+OR+LLM+OR+GPT&points=100', trust: 3 },
  { category: 'world', source: 'BBC News', url: 'https://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/world/rss.xml', trust: 5 },
  { category: 'world', source: 'NPR', url: 'https://feeds.npr.org/1004/rss.xml', trust: 5 },
  { category: 'world', source: 'The Guardian', url: 'https://www.theguardian.com/world/rss', trust: 4 },
  { category: 'world', source: 'Al Jazeera', url: 'https://www.aljazeera.com/xml/rss/all.xml', trust: 4 },
  { category: 'world', source: '연합뉴스', url: 'https://www.yna.co.kr/rss/international.xml', trust: 4 },
];

return feeds.map((f) => ({ json: { ...f, config } }));
